Author: Rayla Petal
Name: Corruption
Description:
Earn XP and arousal when you and a nearby player with the plugin both play animations from mods you each picked in Penumbra. Level through corruption tiers, climax into Cummy layers, bond with a regular partner, earn and wear titles, spend Sins in the shop, and opt into a full pregnancy system. Everything runs locally.
Requires Penumbra, SimpleHeels and a sync service such as Lightless. Cummy, Glamourer, Moodles and Intiface Central are optional. 18+ content.
Punchline: Earn corruption with someone nearby while your animations play.
Changelog:
- Personality and traits: pick one of 13 personalities and up to two of 14 traits at setup. Each gives a bonus and a drawback, like Shy, Exhibitionist, Hypersexual or Thrifty, and Easygoing does neither. They're locked until you reset your profile. Characters already set up choose once.
- Chemistry: some personalities suit each other, and scenes between them pay a little more.
- Nearby shows other players' personality and traits, and there's a {personality} nameplate token.
- Fixed the title bar buttons overlapping on Corruption's windows, and the main window's tabs now wrap and line up.
